final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts` and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` following the README. All 3 tests pass with `npm test`.

I also checked edge cases by hand: empty and space-only lists return no ports, touching ranges merge (`10-20,21-30` → `10-30`), malformed items throw, and out-of-range ports throw.

The type check was not run: `npx tsc` tried to fetch from the registry and was refused (403), and `tsc` isn't installed locally.
